ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice was capability-driven: this is a clean quantitative reasoning problem with no sensitive content, so the task-preference notes (which only differ on harm-adjacent material) don't apply. Among capability signals, Plover leads Whimbrel on every reported benchmark—including the reasoning-relevant ones (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4)—at identical cost and latency. So Plover is the better fit for a math problem like this.
